register calls asRecord, requireString and requireNumber to check the shape of the request input, then calls registerProduct.execute and sends res.status(201).json(product). This is input parsing and response mapping, with no business decisions.
listStock calls listProductStock.execute() and returns the result as JSON. It only passes the call to the application layer.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: ProductController is an Express HTTP adapter in the infrastructure layer, and everything it does is transport work. It sets up routes, parses and checks the request body using shared helpers, hands the work to application use cases, and maps the results to HTTP status codes and JSON responses. It holds no business rules, such as stock checks or rules on how products are registered. It does no persistence work and contains no domain logic. All of its responsibilities fit the infrastructure layer.
